`insight:promoter-pledge-group-contagion` | 2026-11-19 | tickers: - | confidence: verified

Indian blow-ups repeatedly ran through promoter-level leverage rather than the listed company's own P&L: Zee/Essel (pledge 59% -> ~90%, promoter stake ~42% -> ~4%), ADAG (near-100% pledges; RCap, RCom, RHFL), Future Group (FRL promoter stake 47% -> 14% via invocations), Satyam (promoter stake ~25% -> ~8.6%, pledged), Kingfisher/UB (cross-guarantees), Cox & Kings. Mechanism: falling price -> margin call -> lenders invoke and dump shares -> further fall (reflexive), often triggered by a credit event elsewhere (IL&FS Sep 2018 froze MF/NBFC lending against shares). Signals: pledge % of promoter holding (disclosed quarterly under SAST; 'encumbrance' incl. non-disposal undertakings); rising pledge while price rises = borrowing against inflated value; listed company guarantees, letters of comfort, FDs or ICDs to group entities; MF/NBFC 'loan against shares' exposure to the group; promoter selling via 'gifts' or off-market transfers (PC Jeweller). Rules: pledge >25% of promoter holding or any rising trend = disqualifier for long-term holding; check all group listed companies, not just the one you own -- contagion is group-wide (Essel, ADAG, Future, IL&FS). SEBI disclosure since 2019 includes encumbrance reasons; track quarterly.

**Links:** part_of -> `insight:disqualifiers`
**Sources:** <https://business-standard.com/article/pf/zee-stock-crash-shows-why-you-should-avoid-firms-with-high-pledged-shares-119013100051_1.html> ; <https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/future-group-shareholders-stare-at-possible-wipeout-of-investments-122042400555_1.html> ; <https://www.businesstoday.in/amp/markets/company-stock/story/zee-shares-hit-over-6yr-low-as-promoters-increase-pledge-to-90-rebounds-debt-repayment-plan-231895-2019-10-07>

`case_study:dominos-2008-2021` · tickers US-DPZ · confidence: verified

IPO July 2004 at $14. Highly levered (securitised debt), it hit ~$3 in Nov 2008 [unverified] and was in the low single digits in early 2009. Dec 2009: CEO-elect Patrick Doyle (CEO Mar 2010) launched the ~$75m 'Pizza Turnaround' campaign on camera admitting customers found the pizza poor, with a new recipe; same-store sales jumped ~14% in Q1 2010 [unverified]. Then a digital-first strategy (Pizza Tracker 2008, online/app ordering, later >half of US sales digital), store remodels, and a 'fortressing' franchise model. Under Doyle the stock rose ~13x (Restaurant Business); Quartz noted it beat Google's return from 2010. Peak ~$567 (Dec 2021) [unverified] ≈ ~180x from the 2008 low, ~65x from 2010. Split: mostly EPS + aggressive buybacks/recaps (negative equity, share count down); P/E moved from ~10x to ~30x+ [unverified]. Drawdown: ~-80% 2007-08 pre-turnaround [unverified]; -~35% 2022. EARLY SIGNAL visible in 2010: the honest relaunch produced an immediate double-digit same-store-sales jump — a measurable demand response — at a ~10x P/E. Who caught it: few documented; later Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a DPZ stake (Q3 2024). Stall: 2022-26 range-bound as US delivery competition and aggregators matured. LESSON: in a franchise model, a product reset that shows up in same-store sales within one quarter, plus leverage-funded buybacks, can produce a 100x; check the first comp print.

- **Start → end:** ~$3 (Nov 2008) [unverified] → ~$567 (Dec 2021) [unverified] (~180x from trough; ~13x under Doyle)
- **EPS vs rerating:** mostly EPS + buybacks; some rerating
- **Max drawdown:** ~-80% pre-2009 [unverified]
- **Early signal:** Q1 2010 same-store sales jump after honest relaunch; digital ordering share
- **Who caught it:** few documented; Berkshire 2024 (late)
- **Ended/stalled:** range-bound 2022-26
- **Lesson:** first comp print after product reset is the signal
- **Sources:** [1](https://qz.com/885979/in-2010-dominos-dpz-admitted-it-made-terrible-pizza-now-its-stock-returns-have-outpaced-googles-googl-goog-in-one-measurement) · [2](https://restaurantbusinessonline.com/financing/five-lessons-dominos-comeback) · [3](https://www.fool.com/investing/2019/11/19/the-secret-behind-dominos-epic-turnaround.aspx) · [4](https://www.nrn.com/people/patrick-doyle-leaves-legacy-success-domino-s)
